ref: ADR-0006 TargetSlots, assumed readings: a SUPPRESS slot creates nothing but keeps its number, so it consumes its child context; SUPPRESS does not count toward minOccurs / maxOccurs; truncated slots keep their numbers; createIf is true for 1 or true in any case (since #51); obs-target-creation decides (#31); the input of obs-target-creation a2.xml
note: Both Skus are skip, so createIf gives SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS. SUPPRESS does not count toward minOccurs, so Row (1..2) has no created occurrence: po:MINOCCURS at T1. If SUPPRESS counted, the run would write the root without a Row.
